subject: Q3 Close: final commit & PO cadence / 72-hour visibility
body:
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Emma Holt <emma@clearwave.com>, procurement@clearwave.com
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2027 16:08:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 Close: final commit & PO cadence / 72-hour visibility

Emma / ClearWave team —

As discussed on the call earlier, we need to lock the final PO and internal billing cadence so the finance team can recognize Q3 revenue. Quick ask: can you confirm the signed PO and expected start date by EOD Thursday (09/30)? That gives us a 72-hour runway to complete procurement and onboarding tasks on our side.

Key items we need from you:
- Signed PO (attached: ClearWave_PO_Draft_4892.pdf)
- Final billing cadence: monthly in arrears vs. quarterly advance
- Production start window (preferred: Oct 4–8)

I'll loop in Priyom for launch coordination and Laura / Neha for close reporting. If you prefer, I can send a one-click DocuSign link once you confirm the PO text.

Thanks — appreciate the push to close this quarter.

—
Karthik Iyer
Account Exec, Americas
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
+1 (650) 555-0139

[Attachment: ClearWave_PO_Draft_4892.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: pricing-sheet-q3.xlsx (xlsx)]

----
From: Emma Holt <emma@clearwave.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 09:12:17 -0400
Subject: Re: Q3 Close: final commit & PO cadence / 72-hour visibility

Thanks Karthik —

We reviewed the draft with procurement and legal this morning. Two small asks:
1) Can you change the invoice terms to Net 45 (procurement insists)
2) We need a teeth-on-the-ground start date of Oct 11 instead of the earlier window you suggested — still within Q4 ops timing for us.

I'll forward the procurement mailbox once they create the PO; expect that by EOD tomorrow. If Net 45 is a hard blocker, tell me and we'll expedite internal sign-off accordingly.

—
Emma Holt
VP, Data & Product
ClearWave Inc.
emma@clearwave.com

----
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Emma Holt <emma@clearwave.com>, procurement@clearwave.com
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 Close: final commit & PO cadence / 72-hour visibility

Emma — great, thanks for the quick run. Net 45 is workable but it affects revenue recognition timing and invoice cutoffs for the quarter. Two proposals:

Option A (preferred): Keep the service start Oct 11, Net 45, and we recognize the contract as committed revenue this quarter with a forecast note. Finance will need the signed PO by 09/30 23:59 PT.

Option B: Move to Net 30 and start Oct 4 — this allows clean recognition in Q3 and reduces accounting overhead.

Which would you prefer? I can draft the brief for procurement to speed the signature.

—
Karthik

----
From: procurement@clearwave.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, Emma Holt <emma@clearwave.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 14:21:05 -0400
Subject: Re: Q3 Close: final commit & PO cadence / 72-hour visibility

Hi Karthik —

Procurement here. We can turn the PO around by tomorrow (09/29) if the invoice term remains Net 45. We flagged one language item around data processing that we asked legal to clarify; otherwise the PO is in final routing.

Procurement contact: procurement@clearwave.com

Best,
ClearWave Procurement

----
From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2027 07:48:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: clearwave close play — 72h checklist

Team — quick internal checklist before we push this into the close slate: 
- Finance: confirm recognition approach for Option A vs B (Laura)
- Legal: confirm the data-processing clause edit is non-blocking (Neha)
- Ops: schedule onboarding sprint starting Oct 11 (if Option A) or Oct 4 (if Option B)
- Sales: secure signed PO by EOD 09/29 (Karthik)

Laura — can you confirm which option we prefer for revenue reporting? If we push Option A, I need a forecast note and the revenue flag before EOD.

—
Priyom
Director, Revenue Operations
priyom_das@redwood.ai

----
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, Emma Holt <emma@clearwave.com>, procurement@clearwave.com
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 Close: final commit & PO cadence / 72-hour visibility

Folks — after running the numbers, Finance recommends Option A: accept Net 45 with signed PO in by 09/30 and mark as "committed" for Q3 reporting. We'll add the forecast note to the close pack and reconcile timing in October.

Action items: 
- Emma / ClearWave: please send signed PO to procurement@clearwave.com and cc me (laura_bennett@redwood.ai) by EOD 09/29 PT.
- Karthik: prepare DocuSign link (if ClearWave prefers) and update HubSpot deal HW-2027-0091 to "Commit - Pending Invoice".
- Priyom: include the forecast note in the Q3 close deck; I'll provide the language.

If procurement needs an extra clause confirmation, looping Neha (legal) should unblock quickly.

Thanks — this keeps Q3 clean and avoids a late revenue adjustment.

—
Laura Bennett
VP Finance, Revenue
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

[Link: https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deal/HW-2027-0091]
